grammarFocus: 名词性从句入门；that 从句；情态动词与条件表达。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. title: The Museum of Uncertain Things
instructions: 阅读一篇关于博物馆如何解读不确定证据的短文，完成10道阅读理解题（单选题、填空题、标题匹配题、判断题）。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。
passage:
A. The Museum of Uncertain Things is a small museum in a quiet town. It opened last year. The museum shows objects that are not fully understood. For example, there is a broken stone with strange marks. Nobody knows who made it or what the marks mean. The museum does not say, "This is a message from ancient people." Instead, it says, "We are not sure. Here are three possible ideas." Visitors can read the ideas and think for themselves.

B. The museum's director, Dr. Chen, explains the museum's rule. "We must be honest," she says. "If we do not know, we say we do not know. We can show what we think, but we must not pretend." The museum uses a simple system. Each object has a label with three parts: "What we see," "What we think," and "What we do not know." For the broken stone, the label says: "What we see: marks on stone. What we think: maybe a map, maybe a game, maybe art. What we do not know: who made it and why." This system helps visitors understand that evidence can be uncertain.

C. One day, a school group visited the museum. A boy named Leo asked, "Why don't you just guess? It would be easier." Dr. Chen smiled. "Guessing is easy," she said, "but it is not honest. If we guess, people may believe us. Then they will be wrong. We want people to think, not just believe." Leo thought about this. He said, "So you are teaching people to be careful?" Dr. Chen nodded. "Yes. And we are teaching them that it is okay to say 'I don't know.'"

D. The museum also has a room called the "Question Room." In this room, visitors can write their own ideas about the objects. They can write questions, too. The museum puts some of these notes on the wall. One note says, "Maybe the marks are a calendar." Another says, "I think it is a child's drawing." Dr. Chen says that these notes are important. "They show that people are thinking," she says. "That is what we want."

E. Not everyone likes the museum. Some people say it is too negative. They want clear answers. They say, "A museum should tell us the truth, not just ask questions." Dr. Chen understands this. "We do tell the truth," she says. "The truth is that we do not always know. That is a real answer, too." She believes that if people learn to accept uncertainty, they will be better thinkers. "In science, we often do not know," she says. "But we can still explore. That is the most important thing."

F. The museum is now planning a new exhibit. It will show objects from the ocean. Dr. Chen says, "We will use the same system. We will show what we see, what we think, and what we do not know." She hopes that more museums will follow this idea. "If we all pretend to know everything," she says, "we will never learn. But if we say 'we are not sure,' we can start a real conversation."

grammar.title: 名词性从句入门：that 从句与情态动词/条件表达
grammar.explanation: 英语中，一个句子可以充当另一个句子的主语、宾语或表语，这叫名词性从句。本课重点：1) that 从句作宾语或表语，that 常可省略，但正式文体常保留。例如：She believes that people can learn. 2) 情态动词 must, can, may, should 后接动词原形，表示义务、能力、可能性或建议。3) 条件句：if + 一般现在时，主句用 will/can/must 等。例如：If we guess, people may believe us. 注意：条件从句中不用 will。
grammar.example: She believes that if people learn to accept uncertainty, they will be better thinkers.

options: She says that the museum is honest.
She says that the museum is honest?
She says what the museum is honest.
She says that is the museum honest.
answers: She says that the museum is honest.
questions.explanation: that 从句作 says 的宾语，语序为陈述句语序。
questions.evidence: She says that the museum is honest.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: If we ______, people may believe us.
questions.explanation: if 条件从句用一般现在时，主语 we 用动词原形 guess。
questions.evidence: If we guess, people may believe us.

questions.explanation: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形 be。

options: I think that it is a child's drawing.
I think that is it a child's drawing.
I think what it is a child's drawing.
I think that it a child's drawing.
answers: I think that it is a child's drawing.
questions.explanation: that 从句中 it is 不能省略 is，且用陈述语序。
questions.evidence: I think that it is a child's drawing.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: If people learn to accept uncertainty, they ______ better thinkers.
questions.explanation: if 条件句用一般现在时，主句表示将来结果，用 will be。
questions.evidence: If people learn to accept uncertainty, they will be better thinkers.

options: The museum may show three possible ideas.

answers: The museum may show three possible ideas.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 may 后接动词原形 show。
questions.evidence: The museum may show three possible ideas.

answers: She believes that we can still explore.

questions.evidence: She believes that we can still explore.

questions.evidence: If we all pretend to know everything, we will never learn.
